'''Amaya Kymeri''' was the [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]] of the [[Howling Crag Clan]], a clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Many members of her clan became infected from the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|blackwing virus]], and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] began trying to [[Death/Legends|kill]] most of the clan to contain the outbreak. Kymeri died from this attack, though she later appeared to a spacer as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] to send the spacer to kill the [[Sisters of the Void]] (three infected witches that used spells to survive the attack).<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amaya Kymeri appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Amaya Kymeri was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced upon the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]] on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
